title: Ballistics
body:
a simple mod "focusing on explosives"
contains drug reference
# Features ## Items ### Rocket Handling Glove A new item which allows a "dash" when used with a firework. ![Glove](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/852f74b48dce289483a402e5d9c16aa556c4d0c2.png)
Enchantments ``` > Handling Discards all fall damage for a short time during a dash. Levels increase the time fall damage is discarded. > Graceful After a dash, the firework used shoots out of your hands. > Gripping Increases the amount of time you dash, turning it into more of a flight. ```
### Flintlock A new ranged weapon.
It's projectile does a consistent 16 damage and breaks shields for 5 seconds.
In order to load it, you must put it with a Ball inside of a crafting table.
Hitting someone with this item breaks their shield for 1 second. ![Flintlock](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f213f390fc0c72d247aecab45a0e061ee1e5ac3.png)
Crafting Materials ![Flintlock Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c2c6f3b58944d066f7c19c92bbf8aa540085742.png) ![Flintlock Barrel and Ball](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e2b957edba2a57da7be7e3431ae5a70169e4dfc.png)
Ball (Ammo) & Flintlock Barrel
Enchantments ``` > Quick Load Allows you to load the Flintlock by carrying a Ball in your other hand while charging it. > Bluntness Gives extra damage to it linearly using attributes. > Deadeye Does literally nothing yet because I forgot to code it. Sorry! ```
### Flask Acts like a Glass Bottle.
Can craft with a potion to transfer its effects to the flask. You cannot brew using this.
Drinking out of a flask is twice as fast as a regular potion.
You can stack filled flasks up to 4. ![Flask](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c968a6a427a9543fb3cc5ca9ad34683e5f8fd7fd.png) ### Drink Mixer Cannot drink using this.
Craft with up to 4 different potions to combine them.
Craft with up to 4 different flasks to transfer its effects to them.
Combined potions may only be put into a drink mixer before a certain level. ![Drink Mixer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f068a5f9011c4ce4aa0f0281723fb176beb4e0ec.png) ### Smokes Using will continiously apply a potion effect.
Pick Low Durability
Can craft with a potion to apply it to the pick. ![Pick](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae546988fe3ab92d20a9a33e5e76836b526346f7.png)
Cig Medium Durability
By default, it has Regeneration and Nausea. It's effects cannot be changed in survival mode. ![Cig](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2f14de65a5b24a614f1c9a5e972a3ff7a02d5b4d.png)
Vape High Durability
Can craft Cartridges with a Potion to apply the effects to the Cartridge.
Can craft Vapes with a Cartridge, the Cartridge's effects will be applied to the vape. These can be swapped out at any time. ![Vape](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82efe2d13f3da83fce49f86d1a8224979cae08ef.png) ![Cartridge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e4021cf41124822b98726e8a28800650e65aba9.png)
### W Craft any block with a Brick in a crafting table. ### Firework Launcher creative only item, a crossbow that can only load fireworks and does so by default ## Firework Revamp ### Rocket Jumping explains itself ### Firework Damage Firework Damage has been remade while trying to stick close to vanilla.
Graph If the embed is broken, here is the [Desmos](https://www.desmos.com/calculator/tismlizpcm) link
## nice :) - You can now use fireworks to dash as if you're using a Rocket Handling Glove when you are crawling. - Items now carry over Momentum from the Player. - End Crystals (as dropped items) will explode on impact at high speeds. # Compatibility This mod *should* work with most other mods.
custom lang files may be needed for nonvanilla potions on flasks # Credits ``` LLEVC (thats me, hi) - Main Developer kaidoisbetter - Main Playtester Fr3ber - Playtester, Flintlock Sounds NorthernCosmos - Playtester Cametized - Light Playtester Stzck - Light Playtester ```
